payload.rendered_briefing: 以固定源码实际行为及叙述语境审核全部冻结条目，覆盖语义完整性、机制、术语、占位符和跨条一致性。固定版本的相关公开源码摘录在 /workspace/tome4-chinese-translation/.ai/task/repair-w2-20260921/SOURCE-ANCHORS.json，可读取该引用。该文件仅含源码路径、commit及逐字摘录；必要时沿调用链查询同 commit。每条可编辑范围只包含冻结 source，不包含邻近条目。
payload.terminology_snapshot: 本次没有术语库修改。既有同语境译名：Master Summoner（talent name）=召唤精通；Rimebark=雾凇；Battle Call（talent name）=挑衅；Garkul the Devourer=吞噬者加库尔；Atamathon=阿塔玛森；Age of Pyre=烈火纪。

translation_snapshot.source: In the Age of Pyre the giant golem Atamathon was built with the sole purpose of stopping the orcish leader Garkul the Devourer. The golem was single-handedly destroyed by the orc, who then slaughtered an army of thousands before the demonic fighter was finally slain.
translation_snapshot.target: 在烈火纪，人们建造巨型傀儡阿塔玛森的唯一目的，就是阻止兽人首领吞噬者加库尔。加库尔仅凭一己之力便摧毁了这尊傀儡，随后又屠戮了一支数千人的军队，最终这名如恶魔般的战士才被杀死。

translation_snapshot.source: These gloves make you feel rock steady! These magical gloves feel really soft to the touch from the inside. On the outside, magical stones create a rough surface that is constantly shifting. When you brace yourself, a magical ray of earth energy seems to automatically bind them to the ground, granting you increased stability.
translation_snapshot.target: 这副手套令你感觉稳如磐石！这副魔法手套的内侧触感极其柔软，外侧则由不断变动的魔法石构成粗糙表面。当你稳住身体时，一道大地能量形成的魔法射线似乎会自动将它们固定在地面上，让你站得更稳。
